title: Tom's Trip to Italy
text:
Last month, Tom visited Italy for the first time. He flew to Rome and stayed in a small hotel near the station. Every morning, he walked to the old Colosseum and took photos. The food was cheap and very tasty.

On the last day, Tom went to a quiet town by the sea. He took a bus there, and the trip lasted two hours. At the beach, he swam and ate fresh fish. He said it was the best day of his trip.

options: In a small hotel near the station

questions.text: How did Tom travel to the quiet town?

options: He enjoyed the trip very much
He wanted to leave Italy early

a sandy area next to the sea

paragraph_translations: Geçen ay Tom ilk kez İtalya'yı ziyaret etti. Roma'ya uçtu ve istasyonun yakınındaki küçük bir otelde kaldı. Her sabah eski Colosseum'a yürüyüp fotoğraf çekti. Yemekler ucuz ve çok lezzetliydi.
Son günde Tom denize yakın sessiz bir kasabaya gitti. Oraya otobüsle gitti ve yolculuk iki saat sürdü. Plajda yüzdü ve taze balık yedi. Bunun gezisinin en güzel günü olduğunu söyledi.
